policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

claims.label: derived
claims.text: Concordia Irvine's seventeen goals are more than Jessup, Hawai'i Hilo and Biola have scored together, yet they have conceded fifteen.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Concordia Irvine won at Biola and now have more wins than any other programme.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Jessup's defeat by Dominican (Calif.) on Tuesday was their fifth against two wins and one draw; they have scored seven goals and conceded seventeen.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Point Loma drew with Westmont on Saturday and have three wins, three draws and two defeats, with fifteen goals scored and eleven conceded.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Twelve matches dated in August still carry no published result, the earliest of them Vanguard's on the season's first day; the Vanguard matches that do have a score have brought one win, one draw and five defeats.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Hawai'i Hilo have lost three matches in a row after opening with three wins; the defeat at MSU Denver leaves them with five goals scored and five conceded.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Chaminade have been beaten in all six matches they have played, scoring three goals and conceding fifteen; their next match is at Point Loma on Thursday.
